summary: Describes an architecture for securing Internet routing, built on the Resource Public Key Infrastructure. The RPKI reflects how IP address space and AS numbers are allocated, and a distributed repository stores the signed objects. A first use is letting the holder of address space authorize which network may originate routes for it. It is informational.

eli5.summary: Who owns an internet address? This explains a system of digital certificates that proves it, so a network can show it is allowed to announce an address, like a deed at a registry.

questions: how to secure bgp route origin
